# abapGit standalone source

`zabapgit_standalone.prog.abap` is the standalone abapGit program published by
the abapGit project. It was downloaded from:

`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abapGit/build/main/zabapgit_standalone.prog.abap`

Refresh this file from that upstream location when updating the bootstrap
instructions. Refer to the upstream abapGit project for its license and notices.
